data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 11.073m. The gross claims development triangle shows adverse development on prior underwriting years (principally the 2013 year) of approximately GBP 11.24m, driven mainly by adverse development in Third Party Liability and to a lesser extent Property, resulting in a net strengthening of reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (11.24m) was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (figures presented in GBP 000). Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding prior-year comparative = 11,073 GBP 000). LOB-specific movements are only reported in the notes as net movements; gross-by-LOB prior-year movements were not provided, so net amounts have been used for LOB entries (flagged with lower confidence). No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years are mentioned. All monetary conversions: GBP 000 -> millions.
